items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: We used to have corner players just come in and sit in, you know, like Johnny Lala, Manny Blessie, Paul Merez, and a few guys.

ctx.x: that, I really wanted to, well in, well in 24 and 25, even though I had my store, I worked

for the Count Van Aachen and the company too. And I didn't know that they were doing it, of course the fellow that was the owner of the store, he used to be around the store at night after it was cold, always come up and see me and I would tell. And he said to me, you know, he said, man, I'm not selling any drums, he said, man, I have a tough time, he said, why don't you come down and sell some drums and some instruments for me, he said, I'll make it worth your while. So I said, okay, I said, I'll do that, I told…
What Shillin is that? George Happy.
